title: E2E.Test.Nested.Direct.7z.MHE.First.Password.2026.1080p-TESTGRP
description: An LZMA2 7z with -mhe=on holding an ordinary member and a stored, unencrypted 7z. The job's own password is the right one; nested-direct-7z-mhe-second-password is the same shape with the right candidate second. The set demotes with 7z_encrypted_content, and the direct-unpack chase must arm and have its members installed.
